title: References in Cad Model Definition Document
description: CAD references should appear in the workbench document under each model definition branch. References must support hide, lock, selection, and hover reveal like other entities.
summary: CAD play details panel now shows full editable reference inspector (position, tilt, scale, width, opacity, quaternion readout) when a reference is selected, matching puzzle 3d. Wired patchCadPlayReference through runtime command bus and host bridge using shared patchWorldReferenceProps. Fixed duplicate worldReferenceScaleVec export in infinite/world/r3f.
